mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate, indicative of accommodative monetary policy, reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.2% over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPIAUCSL above 0.5 percentage points signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increased by >0.5pp in the prior month over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent acceleration in GDP growth (GDPC1) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong economic momentum, which elevates corporate profit forecasts and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both GDPC1 and RSAFS increased by >0.3% in the prior quarter over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions, a combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and robust industrial output (INDPRO > 95.0) signals overheating, triggering preemptive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0 and INDPRO > 95.0 over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 index level signals weakening manufacturing activity, which typically triggers a reduction in the federal funds rate to stimulate the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 90.0 over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 600.0 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence and construction activity, which correlates with rising corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 600.0 over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A recent decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.1 percentage points over the past 5 trading days indicates immediate monetary easing, which typically boosts short-term equity returns, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined by >0.1pp in the prior 5 days over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 0.5% growth rate signals expanding economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 0.5% in the prior quarter
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 growth exceeded 0.5% in the prior quarter over the past 5 years.
